notes.content:
[h3]Leaderboard highscore demo season 1 will be ending 12/31/23 midnight EST. The top three winners will receive the opportunity to design graffiti for the game! [url=https://discord.com/invite/kx775yS]Join our Discord to learn more.[/url][/h3]

[b]Patch Notes[/b]

Gameplay
[list]
[*] Updated the throwing mechanic again. The normal throw now automatically does a low-throw at short ranges, while the alternative throw is now the lob.
[*] Turned on Aim Assist for everyone. You can disable it in Settings -> Controller.
[*] Added a new hint to the last remaining undiscovered achievement.
[/list]
Bugs
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where you couldn’t switch skills or items (and a few other inputs) when using a gamepad with the controller input value set to anything other than 0.
[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes an interactable item would be invisible, or other times one would appear when its non-interactable (eg from the floor below).
[*] Fixed an annoying camera behavior in a secret area.
[/list]

[b]0.1073 - 12/27/23[/b]

Gameplay
[list]
[*] There’s a new setting under “Gameplay” called “Tutorial” which allows you to disable the tutorial. 
[/list]
Bugs
[list]
[*] Fixed a soft-lock when attempting to go to another room right as you died.
[*] Fixed a bug where enemy attack hitboxes remained active after the enemy was defeated. 
[*] Fixed rare crash when going up a ladder.
[*] Fixed crash if you tried to delete the “Back” button.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause the mutant dog to freeze in place and become unhittable after being knocked into the air.
[*] Fixed bug that sometimes could prevent you from climbing ladders correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.106
notes.content:
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated how the auto-aim works when using a controller to make it more intuitive. R-Cuff is back to doing a low-throw, and the regular throw now acts like a “lob” at short distances. The cursor now is orange and only turns red when locked on to an enemy.
[/list]
[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Reverted a change that made the final boss’ final punch in his combo to remain on screen for longer.
[*] Increased the stun on a regular rocket launcher direct hit 5 -> 6 and the explosion 0 -> 1. It will now always stun a big zombie (assuming it has no stun resist yet).
[/list]

[*] Fixed a bug where teleporting to a phonebooth didn’t set it as your savepoint.
[*] Fixed a few NPC dialogues which had typos / sentences that were cut off.

notes.title: v0.105
notes.content:
Gameplay
[list]
[*] [b]Updated how targeting works when throwing objects.[/b] You can now aim exactly where you want to throw an object. When using a controller, there is an extensive auto-aim system which you can control either via the right thumbstick or the L1 and R1 buttons.
[*] Added one more ringing phone somewhere in the world..
[*] Trash is slightly easier to kick now.
[*] A strong punch on the rubble barriers now instantly destroys them.
[*] Added a new hint update after trying to give “tech support” a drink 5 times.
[/list]
Sound
[list]
[*] Added a new impact landing sound when a character is knocked back or up and hits something.
[*] Beefed up the sounds of landing a power punch and when quickstepping through enemy attacks / immediately punching right after.
[*] Added a low pass filter on the marker sound to remove the high frequencies.
[/list]
UI
[list]
[*] Yes/No buttons are now fully clickable.
[/list]
Bugs
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where hitstun could cause enemy AI to break. The most common example was hitting an enemy right as they were exiting the stun state would cause them to be stuck on their stun animation while chasing.
[*] Fixed a bug where the mobster gunners would sometimes shoot at nothing.
[*] Fixed a crash that could sometimes happen when mobsters and zombies were fighting one another.
[*] Fixed a bug where if starting a new game on story mode, the healing tuorial prompt would not show up when it’s supposed to.
[*] Fixed a crash that could potentially happen when an enemy or Tino is knocked back.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.104
notes.content:
Apologies for the delay in updates / solving bugs. A great deal of effort when into creating the versus mode which was showcased at PlayNYC. If you missed the stream, there will be a video of the game mode uploaded to Youtube sometime in the future!

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a visual guide to help players understand how healing/energy works.
[/list]
[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] The cufflink combos are now much easier to pull off. Previously they would miss if the enemy was too high up in the air.
[*] On easy mode, the window to perform a “strong punch” is now much longer (from about 16 frames to 50 frames).
[*] On easy mode, the window to perform a parry is now much longer (from about 12 frames to 30 frames).
[/list]
[b]Visuals[/b]
[list]
[*] The overhead parallax in the dungeon rooms now is more pronounced and also now includes the light rays shining in through the windows.
[/list]
[b]Sound[/b]
[list]
[*] New audio cues added to represent the yellow and red timing sparks. The yellow one is a short breath out while the red on is a short inhale.
[*] New sound added to indicate the stun effect.
[/list]
[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash when throwing a baseball bat or splozo at the miniboss (and other similar scenarios).
[*] Fixed a bug where if directly above an enemy, the controller aim assist would not hit the target correctly.
[*] Fixed bug where changing the keyboard mappings for block, crouch, and parry did not work.
[*] Fixed a bug where mapping anything other than “Punch” to left click would cause all keyboard keys to also perform that action.
[*] Fixed bug where controller rumble only worked on controller input 0.
[*] Fixed bug where the controller deadzone was only being set for controller input 0.
[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes Tino would not be able to move.
[*] Fixed a bug where the final boss could be stunned during a phase transition via fire damage, interrupting it and breaking the fight.
[*] Bug reports are now automatically sent to the discord server.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v0.103
notes.content:
[b]*Please note*[/b] Major content patches are subject to bugs. There is a chance that a new feature will not work correctly. Please report any issues and we will have them fixed ASAP! We thank you for your patience and understanding. QA while solo developing is challenging!

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated Cufflink Combos. Try comboing an uppercut into a spike or a kick.
[*] Updated how the spike (“Meteor Cufflink”) calculates whether or not it hits an enemy. It should feel much more natural using it now.
[*] 2 new achievements! 
[*] Updated system how attacks calculate whether they hit or not depending on their height compared to the target’s height.
[*] Money now has an infinite pickup range.
[*] Telephones now remove any burning or needle based debuffs.
[*] There was a group of traffic cones on the main diagonal street that dropped two items. That was an oversight and one of the items has been moved to a different nearby group of traffic cones.
[*] A certain potion vendor now instantly wakes up when a certain creature is close. In addition, refusing the offer is now pointless.
[*] New NPC appears in a secret area when a certain condition is met.
[*] After defeating the final boss, there is now a new note that can be read back at the station.
[/list]
[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] SPLOZO explosions do a lot more stun damage now.
[*] Made the hitbox that thrown items use to detect a hit bigger.
[*] In the final boss’ final phase, he now will jump up to the rafters every 30 seconds guaranteed (giving you more chances to breathe).
[*] Parrying certain high power attacks no longer stuns enemies but instead applies 0.5 sec of hitstun. 
[/list]
[b]Sounds[/b]
[list]
[*] When you’re about to get stunned a heartbeat sound now plays.
[*] Randomized the pitches of many different sounds which tend to play multiple times at once (eg 5 traffic cones being bounced at once).
[*] Slightly updated the phone ringing sound for those who are averse to it.
[/list]
[b]Visuals[/b]
[list]
[*] When an enemy or Tino is stunned for more than 1 sec, the spinning dizzy sprite will show multiple times per extra second (up to 3).
[*] Added a bit of color to the entrance stairs to 61st St Station to help catch the eye more. There’s also a new loot box there to entice you in that direction.
[*] Added parallax on the overhead objects in the Branzino Cellar rooms.
[*] Updated the parallax on clouds to be based on camera position.
[*] The bricks from the miniboss encounter no appear above you.
[/list]
[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where pausing and exiting the game while in the air falling right after a room transition, Tino would spawn in out of bounds and your save file would essentially be locked out. The solution is that you now cannot pause during this specific scenario. I had previously mentioned that this was fixed in the last patch, but I had accidentally left the code for the fix commented out.
[*] Fixed a bug preventing cargoyles from taking damage when crashing into solid objects at high speeds.
[*] Fixed a bug that was often preventing cars from blowing up when a cargoyle crashes into them.
[*] Fixed a bug where throwing an item at certain diagonal walls would get it stuck inside the wall.
[*] Fixed a bug where picking up a tutorial note didn’t trigger the achievement check. 
[*] The dialogue for a certain phone call only happens once now.
[*] Fixed a bug where when holding something, there was a scenario where you would stop holding it but remained in the holding state.
[*] Fixed a few areas where it was possible to get out of bounds using the spike cufflink.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.102
notes.content:
Big thanks to everyone who has provided feedback and reported bugs!!! This demo is work in progress and we thank you for your patience with any (new) issues that may pop up.

[b]Gameplay[/b]
Added hitstun! Regular enemies are now stunned by Tino’s attacks (this is different from the stun state, and happens on every attack). The more powerful the attack the more hit stun.

[b]Controls[/b]
Tapping move while blocking now causes you to quickstep.

[b]Balance[/b]
While stunned or getting knocked back, Tino’s stun timer can no longer be increased. This was causing him to be stunned for longer than 2 sec sometimes.
Tino now has slightly more invulnerable frames after taking damage (12 -> 20)
The damage of the rocket upgrade explosions has been reduced (30->20)
The final boss will now no longer chain grab you.
Dodge rolling now can be used to avoid car based attacks.
The final boss’ drift attack now knocks you back further. This should prevent you from getting hit multiple times by it (in theory).
If you look like a zombie, they will not aggro you.

notes.title: Patch v0.1002
notes.content:
[b]New Season[/b]
Demo Season 1 has begun! The formula for calculating you high score is as follow: 

[b]((Enemies Killed * 200) + (Quartrs * 4) + (5000 per unlock) - (1000 * Deaths)) / Time[/b] 

If playing on easy difficulty the entire score is divided by 2. This season will last for at least 1 month! Rewards will be announced at a later date!

[b]New Achievements [/b]
A few new/updated visible achievements, and a whole lot of hidden achievements. Happy hunting!!! 
Added a few new hint trash items throughout the world.

[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Tino can now only be stunned a maximum of 2 sec by a single attack.
[*] Tino now receives 50% less stun resistance after being stunned.
[*] Previosuly you were unable to parry attacks that knocked you back. This has been changed (although you still are unable to parry car-based attacks).
[*] The final boss’ 2nd phase received minor changes. The fire’s hitbox is now smaller and during the initial speed up of the drive, getting hit by the front does greatly reduced damage and knockback.
[/list]

[b][url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Skj_KNc1Hw9hYknxMXW1kcONSB7AtolzZ2vgcwr7dM8/edit?pli=1]Full patch notes
[/url][/b]

notes.title: Bad Boro v0.0999
notes.content:
[b]Parry update[/b]
[list]
[*] Parry now happens always right as you block and no longer requires a separate input press.
[*] Active parry duration has been increased up to 12 frames.
[*] A block now always lasts for a minimum of 30 frames (0.5 sec). You can quickstep out of it early at any point.
[*] Parry now stuns the enemy for 2 sec. In addition, a a successful parry now stuns all enemies around you for 1 sec.
[/list]

[b]Other Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated how the hitbox of thrown objects are calculated. 
[*] The aim assist feature has been updated to work for regular punches. Also, its detection arc now scales depending on how close an enemy is and better prioritizes closer enemies. 
[*] Enemies are now attracted to loud sounds. Try using this to your advantage in order to sneak past certain enemies.
[*] Balance
[*] Enemies & Tino now gain stun & knockback resist after being stunned or knockbacked. 
[*] Water bottles now only gain you 1 extra healing charge.
[*]Controller controls were updated in v0.0998 to be more intuitive.
[/list]

notes.title: Bad Boro v0.0994
notes.content:
0.0994 - 5/22/23
[list]
[*] [b]Updated player and enemy hitboxes![/b] Before this patch hitboxes outlined the majority of a character. However, considering the perspective of the game it created awkward situations where you could, for example, punch enemies’ toes to damage them. With this patch hitboxes have been greatly reduced in size, and for enemies they are now placed more or less at Tino’s punching height. Considering Tino’s fists still have huge hitboxes, this change should be subtle but you will definitely notice that positioning matters more.
[*] Some of these hitboxes react to specific character movements. For example when Tino is crouching, his hit hitbox now reflects that and is lowered. When enemies use lunging attacks their hitboxes follow them as they jump. Going forward I’ll be updating these to be even more accurate.
[*] [b]Phonebooth update! [/b]- You can now fast travel between telephone booths (for a nominal fee of 25 quartrs).
[*] The phonebooth menu has been redesigned to match NPC dialogue options. All phonebooths will now be ringing the first time you encounter them, making it easier to locate savepoints. The ability to make phone calls will be coming in a future patch probably. 
[*] Updated the text on tutorial notes and scattered them accross the map.
[*] Added a couple of tutorial notes that appear in the notes section of your inventory.
[*] Updated the controls tutorial at the game start to be clearer.
[*] Updated many NPC dialogues. Some existing dialogue lines have been gated behind special in-game triggers.
[*] Various balance changes and bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Bad Boro v0.0993
notes.content:
[h3]In case you're not in our Discord, here's a link to the detailed patch notes that we've been keeping:[/h3]

[h1][url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Skj_KNc1Hw9hYknxMXW1kcONSB7AtolzZ2vgcwr7dM8/edit?pli=1]Bad Boro Patch Notes[/url][/h1]

We'll start posting these notes to steam as well (too bad that we can't format them the same..)

0.0993 - 04/21/2023
[list]
[*] Block can now be held indefinitely and provides a constant 30% damage reduction (only while standing still). On a controller the default button is left trigger (L2) and on keyboard it is left shift.
[*] While blocking you can initiate a “Parry” (default “X” on both controller and keyboard). If timed correctly it will interrupt an enemies attack and allow you to attack right away. If missed it will force a 0.5 sec pause on actions.
[*] When you beat the demo and your score makes the leaderboard a notification will be sent to the new “leaderboard” channel.
[*] When you die a message will be sent to the new “rip” channel detailing your cause of death.
[*] Phone booths now reset the enemies in the current room.
[*] There’s now a new phone booth right after the tutorial.
[*] In easy mode Tino now does 4 normal punches before getting tired (in normal mode it’s only 2). 
[*] All damage done in easy mode has been reduced from 2x to 1.5x (to compensate for the above change).
[*] The miniboss’ health has been increased from 600 to 1000,
[*] Fixed crash after going to a new room with a needle stuck in you.
[*] Fixed crash that could happen when an enemy is thrown.
[*] Fixed bug where in the locked dungeon rooms the gate would unlock without all of the enemies in the room having been defeated.
[/list]
